caption: A person bounces to a specific rhythm on a trampoline, their body movement clearly timed to a beat.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A person bounces to a specific rhythm on a trampoline, their body movement clearly timed to a beat. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The person must maintain consistent timing of their bounces to match the rhythm of the music or beat.
Visible changes in body posture must occur with each bounce to emphasize the rhythm, such as arm movements or leg extensions.
The person must land and rebound in a controlled manner to sustain the rhythmic pattern without losing momentum.
The trampoline surface must remain stable and responsive to allow for consistent, rhythmic bouncing.
